text:
Lina: Heads-up: final runbook for the Loft meetup — we need social copy schedule, speaker slide checks, benchmark image, swag counts, and lead flow wiring. Can we split tasks?
Emma: Ill take slide checks + benchmark PNGs. Will send a 1-slide template and a quick sample chart export request to ML.
Carlos: I can own social schedule + launch post copy. Thinking: 2 social posts (pre-event teaser + same-day live tweet) and one recap next-day with a benchmark highlight.
Raj: Logistics update: venue load-in approved, 1 6ft table, power strip, and a dolly. Courier ETA update: pickup tomorrow 09:30 local. Ill be there for handoff.
CourierBot: Pickup confirmed by vendor XpressShip, tracking https://couriers.example/track/XS-9982. Pickup window 2024-08-08 09:30-10:00.
Michelle: Lead capture plan: QR -> Typeform -> HubSpot. Fields: name, email, company, interest_tags (benchmarks/demo/partnership), tshirt_size, role. Need webhook -> HubSpot mapping. Who can do Zapier?
Emma: Ill set up Zapier mapping to HubSpot and test with sample responses. Will tag leads using `interest_tags`.
Lina: Speaker checklist (quick). Please add anything missing:
```
- Slides: 1 intro + 1 demo + 1 benchmark slide (PNG)
- File naming: SpeakerLast_benchmark.png, SpeakerLast_slides.pdf
- Network: list any special ports / keys / demo accounts
- Backup: USB with slides + PDF export
- Arrival: be onsite 30min before start
```
Carlos: For the social posts, here's a starting microcopy. Feel free to edit: 
```
- Pre: "Join us Tue @TheLoft for hands-on demos of low-latency LLM serving. Live bench highlights + Q&A. RSVP: <link> #redwoodllm"
- Live: "Live from @TheLoft  demos underway. Bench: <1/2 tokens/ms> chart in slides. Drop by booth!"
- Recap: "Recap: we cut inference cost by X% at 95th pctile latency in our demo. Slides + recording: <link>"
```
Michelle: For the recap blog we should get a 2-paragraph narrative: (1) event vibe + demo summary, (2) benchmark takeaway + CTA to webinar. Also create a short gated asset for people who want deeper benchmark details.
Emma: ML team asked for the exact chart spec: x-axis = throughput (rps), y-axis = cost per 1k tokens (USD), lines = model variants (quantized/float). Can we commit to PNG export by EOD today?
Lina: Emma, can you confirm with ML and upload to the shared drive. Carlos, can you pick the visual for the social card from that PNG?
Raj: Quick question on swag counts: ordered 120 tees (mix S-XL), 400 stickers, 150 postcards. If walkups exceed RSVP, we may blow through stickers fast. I can stash 100 extras in the office van.
CourierBot: Reminder scheduled: courier will message when crate is scanned at depot (ETA updates to this thread).
Carlos: Also recommending a small on-site giveaway mechanic: QR scan + drop business card in the bowl for a tee raffle. Adds lead capture and generates foot traffic. Thoughts?
Michelle: Love it. Add a checkbox on Typeform: "Enter raffle for a free tee" and map that tag to marketing. Also set automation: raffle entrants get a thank-you email and a note about webinar.
Lina: Webinar follow-up plan: 30-40min panel 10 days after event. Tasks: landing page + registration, speaker permission to record, and nurture email flow (3 emails). Michelle can own landing page; Emma owns speaker opt-ins.
Emma: Will add a permission checkbox on the speaker form: "I consent to recording and post-event distribution". Also will ensure slides PDF uploaded to shared folder `marketing/meetups/loft-aug/`.
Raj: On arrival I'll take photos of the booth and upload one hero image to the thread for the recap social post.
Carlos: Who's drafting the benchmark narrative snippet for the live recap card? I can do the short headline but need a precise percent or latency metric.
Emma: ML can provide a rounded number for the recap: aiming to confirm a 30% cost reduction at 95th pctile vs baseline. I'll lock the final stat 2 hours after the run.
Lina: Final checklist to close before courier pickup:
- Emma: slides + PNGs (due today)
- Raj: onsite for pickup + photo of crates on arrival
- Carlos: social copy + campaign schedule (due tomorrow noon)
- Michelle: Typeform + HubSpot mapping + raffle checkbox (due today afternoon)
- All speakers: submit slides + network needs by EOD
Anything else?
Carlos: Can we also get a tiny one-liner for the eventbrite blurb: "Hands-on demos and benchmarks from Redwood Inference: engineers welcome". I'll add it.
Lina: Great. If no blockers, I'll mark this thread as the single source for day-of updates. Ping here if anything slips. :rocket:
